title: Agent Package v1
description: Runtime contract for a deployable agent package. A package declares one Digital Worker, the agents composing it, the skills each agent invokes, the tools each skill calls, orchestration policy, invariants, HITL gates, SLOs, and context bindings. The package is the only thing the platform compiles and executes — everything use-case-specific lives here, not in platform code. Schema is the contract; typed DSL authoring (TypedPackage) compiles to this JSON shape.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema's location, useful for IDE autocomplete.

registeredIn.description: Agent 365 registry slug; null until registration

digitalWorker.description: Composition of agents with persistent identity (Entra Agent ID), state (Cosmos), accountability (SLOs).

entraAgentId.description: Persistent identity in Entra Agent ID; null until registered

partitionKey.description: Field on the state document used as the Cosmos partition key

corpusBinding.description: Optional declaration of how the platform should resolve subject records from the corpus JSON file. Default (when omitted): arrayKey='claims', subjectIdField='claimNumber' (P&C-shaped historical default). Banking, healthcare, etc. packages declare their own keys.

schemaBinding.description: Track 5 (ADR-0016): declares the Fabric/SQL schema this package's row-level semantic primitives target. The platform's primitives (primary-entity-history, similar-by-attributes, secondary-entity-history) are generic shapes; the package teaches its tables + columns. Without this binding, FabricLakehouseSource falls back to P&C defaults (fact_claims/dim_policyholder/dim_vehicle) for backward compat.

similarityFilters.description: Column names on the primary fact table used for the similar-by-attributes primitive's grouping (e.g., ['incident_type','state'] for Meridian, ['loan_purpose','state'] for banking).

agentRefs.description: IDs of agents composing this DW (resolved against top-level 'agents')

strategy.description: Whole-path = plan upfront; sense-then-act = step-by-step; hybrid = sketch + step + meta-confidence. Hybrid recommended.

stepFormation.description: How runtime steps are formed. Hybrid = declared structure + bounded reasoning zones + invariants.

boundedReasoningZones.description: Constrained regions where an agent-planner may form steps from a limited agent set, with hard step limits and a return point.

invariants.description: Hard constraints enforced across all execution paths

ruleExpression.description: CEL-style expression evaluated by the platform at runtime

trigger.description: CEL-style expression that opens the gate

kind.description: prompt-agent = single LLM call; workflow-agent = multi-step graph; hosted-agent = long-running stateful (e.g. fraud); edge-agent = Foundry Local

ontologyBinding.description: Fabric IQ entity types this agent reads/writes

deploymentTarget.description: Where the agent runs. foundry-local for edge/private; container-apps for self-hosted Aspire services.

skills.description: Knowledge packages: SKILL.md + prompts + scripts + evaluation

evalFile.description: JSONL eval set used by the package compiler's Stage 2 validator

contextBindings.description: Intent-based queries this package routes through the context layer (Fabric IQ + Foundry IQ + Work IQ).

sourceBindings.description: Per-source named-primitive routing for this intent. Key = context-source id (e.g., 'FabricIQ', 'WorkIQ'). Value = list of primitive names the source should invoke (allowing multiple shapes per intent — e.g., row-level history AND aggregated rollup). Empty list / null = 'this source has nothing for this intent'.

decisionJournal.description: Append-only record of every agent decision with provenance.

eventHubTopic.description: Azure Event Hubs (Kafka API) topic name

defaultOrigin.description: GROUNDED = traceable to authoritative source; DERIVED = inferred by an agent

factSubjectKey.description: Column on fact table that identifies an individual subject row

factForeignKey.description: Column that joins fact to dim entity (grouping key)

factDateColumn.description: Column used for ORDER BY DESC

factDescColumns.description: Columns surfaced in the fragment narrative

dimTable.description: Optional dim table for JOIN to enrich display

dimDisplayColumns.description: Columns from dim table used to format the display name

entitySemantics.description: v1.1: ontology entity ID this table represents (e.g. 'acl:Claim', 'acl:Vehicle'). Optional label that flows into traces + docs portal so the runtime is honest about what each Delta table means in the v2.4 auto-claims ontology vocabulary.
